fitAnalysis.assessment:
This is a Weak Fit (30%) for the Senior Customer Enablement Manager role at Figma.

**Gaps:**

optimizedCVData.summary: Educator with 8 years of classroom experience designing and delivering training for diverse audiences, now seeking to bring those skills into a customer enablement role. Comfortable translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance, whether for a room of 140 students, a cohort of 12 colleagues learning a new curriculum, or a parent audience expecting structured updates each term. Tracks learner progress through data, presents findings to senior stakeholders and adapts delivery based on what the numbers show. Currently building Python and data analytics skills independently, reflecting a habit of continuous learning that fits a fast-moving SaaS environment.

experience.position: Teacher of Physics and Head of Year 9
bullets: Designed the department's Year 9 practical curriculum from scratch and trained 12 colleagues to deliver it consistently, acting as the internal subject-matter expert and go-to resource for implementation questions.

Raised the share of Year 11 students reaching grade 5 or above from 71% to 86% over three years by identifying at-risk learners early, adjusting teaching approaches and running targeted one-to-one coaching sessions.
Track progress data for 140 students a year across Years 9 to 13 in spreadsheets, then present findings and recommended interventions to senior leadership each term in a clear, structured format.
Manage ongoing relationships with 210 families through weekly calls and two parents' evenings per term, communicating complex academic information accessibly and handling escalations with care.
Delivered KS3 and KS4 science across mixed-ability groups, adapting explanations and pacing to meet the needs of individual learners.
Founded and ran the school robotics club, coaching 6 students through hands-on problem-solving projects and introducing them to computational thinking.
Collaborated with the wider science department to align schemes of work and share best practice across year groups.
Mentor 8 children aged 9 to 12 on Scratch and introductory Python in evening sessions, breaking down programming concepts into accessible steps for complete beginners.
Developed session plans that build on each other week to week, applying the same curriculum design principles used in the classroom to a non-school setting.
Deepened personal Python skills alongside learners, applying pandas for simple data analysis as part of independent study.

analysis.summary: This CV repositions Daniel's 8 years of classroom teaching as directly transferable to customer enablement and success, emphasising curriculum design, workshop facilitation, stakeholder communication and data-driven progress tracking. Verified metrics and documented skills are foregrounded throughout, while skills absent from Daniel's source documents are excluded to protect credibility.

Dear Hiring Manager,

Figma's largest customers need someone who can take a complex platform and make it genuinely usable for teams across every level of an organisation. That is a problem I've been solving in a different context for eight years: teaching physics to 140 students a year means translating difficult concepts into something that actually lands, then tracking whether it did and adjusting until it does.

As a Teacher of Physics and Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, I designed curriculum, delivered live training for colleagues, and ran one-to-one coaching sessions for students who needed a different approach. I track progress in spreadsheets, present findings to senior leadership each term, and run regular stakeholder calls across a year group of 210 students. Those habits map directly onto what Figma describes: building tailored enablement plans, using data to inform proactive engagement strategies, and communicating clearly with people at every level. I also hold a Coursera Python certificate and am working through the Google Data Analytics Certificate, so the data-driven side of this role is one I'm actively building toward.

I'd welcome the chance to talk through how this background translates to your customer portfolio. I'm available from early November and happy to arrange a call at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
